messages.subject: pixel coordinate of faceted plot
parts:
Hi,

I have a figure generated by the following R codes.

library(ggplot2) 
dat <- data.frame(
   x = rnorm(n=50),
   y = rnorm(n=50*20),
   group = rep(1:20, each=50)
)
ggplot(dat) + geom_point(aes(x,y)) + facet_wrap(~group)

If I save this figure fixing the size 530X530 pixel, is there any way to find the pixel coordinate of each faceted plot? For example the boundary box of plot 1 may be something like; top=15px, left=45px, bottom=145px, right=135px.

How can I find this automatically for all 20 faceted plots? Also, the size of my figure may change.

Thanks for your time. 

Mahbub
